note: Declared backlog for autonomous rounds. A run may never close an item: the runner reports which closure checks the witness already contains and which are still missing. A matching check-name prefix is partial progress only; an item is pending until every declared closure check is present.

kinds.executable: an exact bounded check can be added to experiments/golden_ratio/calibration.py
kinds.documentary: a decision recorded in prose that no run can settle
kinds.human: needs a person: identities, merges, or review

items.question: Does the triple-intersection method separate the Borromean configuration from the unlink and from a pairwise-linked configuration, and does it refuse when its pairwise hypothesis fails?
items.closure_requires: at least three controls named borromean-control-* in the retained witness
items.outcome: Unlink gives zero triple points; a configuration scaled by two gives one triple point with signed sum one; a fixture with pairwise linking number one has its triple judgement withheld.

items.question: Can Milnor's invariant be recomputed from the link complement by a route independent of the triple intersection number?
items.closure_requires: a revised finite contract, since a Wirtinger presentation is new machinery
items.note: Blocked until a contract revision is written; the current contract covers the triple intersection only.
items.progress: contract-v2 verified through the abelian presentation level; contract-v3 declares the Magnus step and its validation targets; the Magnus core is validated on classical identities; the twelve Wirtinger relation words are now built in process from exact parameters and agree with the abelian rows; the extraction rule and the two validation targets remain
items.blocked_by: the extraction rule: mu-bar(123) as the coefficient of the degree-two commutator part of each component's longitude Magnus expansion; the longitude word needs the framing rule for under- and over-passages, which must be validated on both targets before any number is read
items.round_five_note: A partial attempt at the relation words was written and then reverted rather than committed half-working: the arc lookup compared serialised string parameters, and even with that fixed the extraction rule is still outside contract-v2.

handoff.step_one: build each component's longitude word from the declared diagram: walk the component and insert a meridian factor at every crossing, with the sign taken from the crossing sign and the factor inverted where the component passes over
handoff.step_two: expand each longitude with the validated truncated Magnus algebra in magnus.py at degree three
handoff.step_three: read mu-bar(123) from the degree-two commutator coefficient of the longitude, which is where Milnor's invariant sits when the pairwise linking numbers vanish
handoff.validation_before_reading: the unlink target must give zero and the Borromean configuration must give plus or minus one; if either target fails, the run stops as Unknown and no number is reported
handoff.why_it_is_not_done: the framing convention needs iterative debugging, and this line's session budget ran out; a fresh session should start at step one with the two targets

items.question: Do the Penrose matching rules force aperiodicity, and is a full-plane tiling accepted?
items.note: The atlas did not attempt this either; the prototiles and inflation are checked, the acceptance layer is not.

items.question: Should the delivered plotting script be run?
items.note: Decision: no. It needs external libraries and its rendering is not evidence; its three panels' mathematical content is checked exactly instead.

items.question: Should research/golden-ratio-receipt-calibration and research/golden-ratio-continuation be consolidated into one line?
items.note: Touches shared branches and main; needs the direction to decide.

items.question: Is the Pascal-style three-party task and witness presentation to be built for the golden-ratio material?
items.note: Three Human identities and the native importer do not exist.
